newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom to sell AGF stake.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom to sell AGF stake.

text.p: France Telecom will sell its stakes in insurers AGF and AXA-UAP when the price is right. The share price of AGF is currently at that level, chairman Michel Bon told La Tribune in an interview.
"Some (of our stakes) have no strategic interest. Our holdings in AGF, UAP AXA will be sold when the share price allows it. The share price of AGF allows it already," he said.
A France Telecom spokesman said the group had 0.21 percent in UAP-AXA and 2.2 percent in AGF.

Michel Bon added that the company's stake in Havas had no strategic value anymore. The stake is 3.5 percent following a deal in which Generale des Eaux sold its Canal Plus stake to Havas in exchange for shares.

France Telecom took its original stake in Havas in relation with the ODA company which manages the yellow pages. But after the Generale des Eaux transaction, France Telecom struck a deal allowing its to acquire full control over ODA.
France Telecom also has a small stake in Cofira, which is a holding company with a stake in mobile telecommunications company SFR.
"I hope that one day we will be able to settle that but it is not a major problem," Bon said.
